scope: Native Vulkan quantised dot product (Q4_K x Q8_K and Q6_K x Q8_K) verified against an independent CPU reference that decodes the same GGML block layouts. This is the kernel prerequisite for GPU Deep2 inference without full-model FP32 expansion.

implementation.device: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700, compute queue family 0
implementation.fp16: half_to_float() in GLSL decodes the Q4_K d/dmin and Q6_K d fields, covering normals, subnormals and infinities.
implementation.no_silent_fallback: ExecuteQuantDot returns false on any validation or dispatch failure. The caller decides; there is no implicit CPU path.

block_layouts_decoded_in_shader.Q4_K_144_bytes: uint16 d, uint16 dmin, uint8 scales[12], uint8 qs[128]
block_layouts_decoded_in_shader.Q6_K_210_bytes: uint8 ql[128], uint8 qh[64], int8 scales[16], uint16 d
block_layouts_decoded_in_shader.Q8_K_per_256: float d, int8 qs[256], int16 bsums[16]
block_layouts_decoded_in_shader.q4_scale_min: 6-bit scales/minima unpacked from 12 bytes exactly as ggml does, including the 4-plus-4 split for the high groups.
block_layouts_decoded_in_shader.q6_layout: Two 128-value halves, each with four 32-value subgroups, 4 low bits from ql and 2 high bits from qh, minus 32 to recentre.
block_layouts_decoded_in_shader.accumulation: Eight independent int32 lanes, then fp32 scaling by (fp16 d) x (Q8_K d), with a separate dmin * bsums term for Q4_K, matching the reference ordering.

independent_cpu_reference: tools/gpu_quant_dot_verify.cpp re-implements the layouts and arithmetic independently of the shader, using synthetic packed weights that exercise the full nibble range.

additional_bug_fixed.issue: Had the same swapped push-constant order {M, K, N} that was already fixed in the synchronous DispatchMatMul. The async path is unused by the current harnesses, so it had gone unnoticed.
additional_bug_fixed.fix: Now sends {M, N, K} to match the shader declaration { m, n, k }.
additional_bug_fixed.note: This was found while re-verifying the Vulkan source after an external process reverted parts of the working tree.

what_this_does_not_establish: End-to-end Deep2 GPU inference. ModelGenieExecutor does not yet call ExecuteQuantDot.
Parity against real GGUF weights. The weights used here are synthetic; real tensors exercise different value distributions.
GPU RMSNorm, attention score/softmax, V aggregation, MoE or KV-cache operations.
Any performance or TPS claim. One invocation per row with host upload and readback is not a tuned matvec.
next: Wire ExecuteQuantDot into one ModelGenieExecutor Layer 0 projection and prove intermediate tensor parity.
Test against real GGUF weights loaded from the model, not only synthetic ones.
Implement the remaining primitives before certifying a GPU-resident Layer 0.
